item.text: [{"task_id":"e3f79277","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    bg = int(round(params['rule'][0]))","    side = int(round(params['rule'][1]))","    scale = int(round(params['rule'][2]))","    zero = int(round(params['rule'][3]))","    one = int(round(params['rule'][4]))","    side = max(1, min(30, side))","    out = np.full((side, side), bg, dtype=int)","    points = np.argwhere(grid != bg)","    if len(points) == 0:","        return out","    rmin = int(np.min(points[:, 0]))","    rmax = int(np.max(points[:, 0]))","    cmin = int(np.min(points[:, 1]))","    cmax = int(np.max(points[:, 1]))","    height = (rmax - rmin + one) * scale","    width = (cmax - cmin + one) * scale","    color = int(grid[rmin, int(points[0, 1])])","    top = rmin == zero","    left = cmin == zero","    for r in range(side):","        dr = r if top else side - one - r","        for c in range(side):","            dc = c if left else side - one - c","            if zero <= dr < height and zero <= dc < width:","                if dr == zero or dc == zero or dr * (width - one) + dc * (height - one) == (height - one) * (width - one):","                    out[r, c] = color","    return out"],"shapes":{"rule":[5]},"params":{"rule":[7,16,2,0,1]},"rationale":"Expand the corner triangle to twice its bounding dimensions on a 16×16 background, preserving its color and corner orientation.
